experience.label: Atlas Mountains Day Trip from Taghazout

heroSection.description: Go beyond the restaurants and learn to cook like a local. Our authentic Berber cooking class takes you into a traditional village home just 15 minutes above the Taghazout coast. You will master traditional Moroccan dishes of your choice — Tagine, Msemen, Couscous, or Rfissa — learn to bake traditional mountain bread, and discover the secret spice blends of the Atlas Mountains. This immersive half-day experience is the perfect way to discover Amazigh and Berber culture through its most famous flavors.

experience.title: THE JOURNEY
experience.subtitle: Traditional Cooking Experience in Taghazout
experience.description: Experience an authentic Berber village cooking journey — pickup from Taghazout, hands-on cooking of your chosen dish and bread making, and a family feast in the Atlas Mountains.

step1.subtitle: Your Adventure Begins
step1.description: We pick you up from Taghazout and take you on a scenic 15-20 minute drive through the stunning Moroccan countryside to an authentic traditional home. Watch the landscape transform as we leave the coast behind.
highlights: Comfortable pickup in from Taghazout Mosque

step2.title: Traditional Kitchen Tour
step2.subtitle: Where Magic Happens
step2.description: Step into an authentic Moroccan kitchen and discover the traditional tools and techniques that have been used for generations. See the wood-fired oven, clay pots, and the workspace where you'll prepare your chosen dish - Tagine, Msemen, Couscous, or Rfissa.
highlights: Make your own tea with the local herbs
Enjoy tea with Moroccan handmade sweets

step3.title: Hands-On Cooking
step3.subtitle: Recipes From Generations
step3.description: In a real Moroccan kitchen, learn authentic cooking techniques passed down through generations. From preparing your chosen traditional dish to baking fresh bread in a traditional wood-fired oven—this is cooking as it's meant to be.
highlights: Prepare your chosen traditional dish (Tagine, Msemen, Couscous, or Rfissa)

step4.title: Feast & Return
step4.subtitle: The Heart of Hospitality
step4.description: Gather around the table in a traditional Moroccan home to enjoy the incredible meal you've created. Share stories, laughter, and experience true Moroccan hospitality before we drive you back to Taghazout.
highlights: Mint tea with a sunset view

experience.finalDescription: Join us for a journey that goes beyond cooking. This is connection, culture, and community—all wrapped in the warmth of Moroccan hospitality.

community.title: Your Meal Supports Village Animals
community.description: Every cooking class directly supports the animals of Tamsoult village. We care for 1 dog, 4 cats, and a flock of 30 chickens — providing food, shelter, and care for the animals that share our community.
community.quote: In Amazigh culture, we believe cooking is not just about food – it's about nourishing our community. When you cook with me, you become part of our village family.

cats.title: The Village Cats
cats.description: Four friendly cats share our village home and kitchen courtyard. Part of every class goes toward their daily meals, shelter, and care — the quiet companions of life in Tamsoult.
cats.imageAlt: Village cats cared for by Taghazout cooking class community in Tamsoult Morocco

chickens.title: The Village Flock
chickens.description: A flock of 30 chickens lives with us in the village. Your class helps keep them fed and safe — and guests often meet them as part of the real rhythm of Amazigh village life.

itinerary.title: The Scenic Ascent
itinerary.description: Meet us at the Taghazout Mosque for a comfortable 15-minute drive into the Small Atlas Mountains. We'll wind through the Argan forest, where you can breathe the fresh mountain air and enjoy a breathtaking panoramic view of the ocean from above.

itinerary.title: A Warm Village Welcome
itinerary.description: Arrive at our village and step inside an ancient 300-year-old Amazigh house, one of the oldest in North Africa. Meet the local family and I will be your guided tour to show you how our ancestors lived in the heart of these mountains.

itinerary.title: The Garden Tea Ritual
itinerary.description: Relax in our authentic workshop and learn the art of Moroccan tea. You'll pick fresh mint and herbs directly from our small garden to brew your own pot. Enjoy your tea with homemade Moroccan sweets I've prepared for you, as we sit together for a warm conversation to get to know one another.

itinerary.title: Prepare The Traditional Bread
itinerary.description: Master the ancient art of village bread. You will knead your own dough by hand before baking it in our traditional stone oven. We fire the hearth with Argan wood, infusing the bread with a rich, smoky aroma and a golden crust that you can only find in the heart of the mountains.

itinerary.title: Your Cooking Masterclass
itinerary.description: Prepare your chosen traditional dish — Tagine, Msemen, Couscous, or Rfissa — using authentic Moroccan spices and techniques in our village kitchen. Cook hands-on with guidance, then let the flavors develop while you continue the experience.

itinerary.title: The Ancient Millstone
itinerary.description: Experience the magic of making your own Amlou using a traditional stone millstone—one of our most ancient tools that we still preserve and use today. You will grind toasted almonds by hand, blending them with pure Argan oil and orange honey to create the most delicious spread you can taste in Morocco.

itinerary.title: The Family Feast & Sunset
itinerary.description: After half day of tradition and cooking, it is time to sit together as one family. Enjoy the delicious meal you created, sharing stories and laughter over your dish and fresh bread. It is more than just a dinner; it is a moment of true Moroccan hospitality in the peaceful heart of the mountains, watching the sunset over the Atlas peaks before we begin our journey back to Taghazout.

itinerary.title: Journey Home
itinerary.description: After the sun sets and we've shared our final goodbyes, we begin the scenic drive back, dropping you directly in Taghazout or Tamraght by 19:30 – 20:00.

meetTheChef.title: Rabab — Taghazout
meetTheChef.paragraph1: I was born and raised in the Atlas Mountains. With a background in Business Management, I launched my own project in 2024, an authentic cooking class and cultural experience, just 15 minutes above Taghazout.
meetTheChef.paragraph2: As an Amazigh woman, my mission is to share my culture with travelers who come to explore beyond the surf. My workshop is a direct collaboration with village women — together, we teach you to prepare traditional Amazigh food using tools and techniques passed down for 10,000 years.
meetTheChef.paragraph3: Every class you join helps bring financial independence to these women and supports our village family — including the cats, chickens, and dog we care for every day.
meetTheChef.paragraph4: In Amazigh culture, we believe cooking is not just about food — it's about nourishing our community. When you cook with me, you become part of our village family.
meetTheChef.ctaDescription: Join me in the mountains for an authentic cultural experience and support our local community.
